finalMessage:
`ostf check --base main` now passes: 40 items, 109 links, all valid.

The check was failing on one link, `payments/refund.go#CheckRefundLimit implements R-REFUND-LIMIT`. It was unstamped, and its `trace.lock` entry was invalid.

I rechecked `CheckRefundLimit` against the item text. The function rejects a refund that exceeds what is left of the charge, and it requires a second approval above 500.00 per account per UTC day. That is what the item says. `TestCheckRefundLimit` and `TestRefundDailyLimit` both pass. I then ran `ostf stamp` on the link, which is what changed `trace.lock`.

I didn't change any code, tests, or `trace.yaml`. The `CheckRefundLimit` item is marked risk-relevant, but I only re-stamped its link.

`trace.lock` is the only modified file, and it is uncommitted. The stamp only refreshed that one lock entry, so the report lists no added items or links.
